stops.stop: Cologne, a figure on the tower
stops.date_confidence: reconstruction: the statue is attested by a captioned photograph on the French Wikipedia article, which corroborates the Fygen Lutzenkirchen adjacency exactly, but neither the German article on the Kolner Rathaus nor the English one lists Agrippa among named figures, and neither enumerates the full roster. The German article dates the figure programme 1988-1995, records all figures removed in 2006 after a conservation failure, and replaced in Savonniere stone from July 2008. So 1988 is the programme's start year, not an installation date, and any figure standing there now is a post-2008 replacement. The Apollinaire and Shelley references are attested from the primary texts.
